source.title: Blind Oath's Shroud — Wowhead Looter PTR 12.1.5 disenchant table
source.author: Wowhead Looter (unidentified aggregated contributors)

notes: PTR 12.1.5 item-side cumulative Looter reference, NOT original per-player event ledger. Both rows are named Dawn Crystal but linked output IDs/ranks unknown: keep separately identifiable as source row 1/2. Selected displayed Mythic ilvl289 is NOT at-cast ilvl, nor does it identify item bonus/quality. Raw material stack units, player skill/spec/build, individual completed event IDs and zero material outcomes unavailable. PTR 12.1.7 view https://www.wowhead.com/ptr/item=250046/blind-oaths-shroud reports larger 44 (29 and 15), overlapping mutable snapshot, NOT an independent additional cohort. LIVE item page had no extractable DE table. Research-only sourceKind reference, excluded from measured estimator.
